final: WITH groups AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS n FROM groups), paired AS (SELECT g.source, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.n AS fraction FROM groups AS g JOIN total AS t ON t.n IS NOT NULL), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS n FROM paired) SELECT p.source, p.cnt, p.fraction, CAST(p.cnt AS REAL) / a.n AS count_over_average FROM paired AS p JOIN avg_count AS a ON a.n IS NOT NULL
